decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm's established laser-marking capabilities and, despite only moderate website prominence, the firm's strong in-house R&D and service base make it likely to refine rather than withdraw this workstation line.

This thermal inkjet printer is close to the firm's core coding offer and remained on its own product page across both years, so the firm is well positioned to learn from market feedback and continue it.

The piezo inkjet printer is also closely related to the firm's existing knowledge base and stayed visibly marketed, which under an absorptive-capacity logic supports retention and incremental improvement.
As a 2024 flagship industrial laser marking line shown on the home page and aligned with the firm's strategic move toward digitalized traceability, it is very unlikely to be removed soon.
The compact laser marking cabin clearly extends the firm's established laser portfolio and was newly given its own page, indicating commitment and a good fit with existing capabilities.

Although more application-specific, this lubricant printing system still builds on the firm's coding expertise and its trade-fair award gives the firm a strong reason to keep developing it rather than exit.
